depiction.primary_object: document page outline with folded top-right corner
modifiers: diagonal arrow at bottom-left pointing up-right into the page
depiction.composition: single object with corner action badge, front view

readings.meaning: import file or data into a document
open file or follow document shortcut

ambiguity: Easy to confuse with export/external-link document icons (where the arrow points outward) or general upload icons at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: import, upload, insert, or open into

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a document page with an inward-pointing diagonal arrow, universally understood as importing, uploading, or inserting into a file. It fits many common digital admin, finance, and work tasks (uploading forms, importing CSVs), though at small sizes the arrow direction can be confused with export or external-link document icons.
